تستلذي (form X)
# تَسْتَلِذِّي (tastaliḏḏī) /tas.ta.lið.ðiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَلَذَّ (istalaḏḏa)
# تُسْتَلَذِّي (tustalaḏḏī) /tus.ta.lað.ðiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَلَذَّ (istalaḏḏa)
